license.notes: BindCraft (martinpacesa/BindCraft) is MIT; ColabDesign (sokrypton/ColabDesign, pinned e31a56fe) is also MIT. The dominant weights are AF2 parameters (CC-BY-4.0, shared with the alphafold2 toolkit). The pipeline requires PyRosetta for its filtering stage — PyRosetta is free for academic/non-profit/government use only, commercial users must obtain a separate license from UW CoMotion (https://www.pyrosetta.org/home/licensing-pyrosetta), and PyRosetta forbids redistribution. ProteinMPNN weights bundled via ColabDesign are MIT.

FreeBindCraft (cytokineking/FreeBindCraft) and upstream BindCraft (martinpacesa/BindCraft) are MIT; ColabDesign (sokrypton/ColabDesign, pinned e31a56fe) is under the Beer-Ware License (Revision 42, Sergey Ovchinnikov) — permissive, permits commercial use, requires only retaining the notice. FreeBindCraft replaces PyRosetta with open-source tools — OpenMM (relaxation), FreeSASA + Biopython (surface analysis), and the sc-rs shape-complementarity binary — so the pipeline carries no PyRosetta license restriction and is safe for commercial hosting. The dominant weights are AlphaFold2 parameters (CC-BY-4.0, shared with the alphafold2 toolkit; attribution required). ProteinMPNN weights bundled via ColabDesign are MIT.

bundled_dependencies.name: IgLM
bundled_dependencies.text: IgLM (Graylab/IgLM) is released for academic, non-commercial use only.

license.notes: Germinal (SantiagoMille/germinal) is Apache-2.0; ColabDesign (Germinal-fork) is MIT. The dominant weights are AlphaFold-Multimer parameters (CC-BY-4.0). The pipeline requires PyRosetta for relax/scoring (UW CoMotion license for academic/non-profit/government use, commercial users must license separately, redistribution forbidden; academic access availability changes, see https://www.pyrosetta.org/home/licensing-pyrosetta) and IgLM (academic non-commercial only, https://github.com/Graylab/IgLM). Chai-1 (Apache-2.0) and AbLang2 (BSD-3-Clause) are also bundled.
Model weights at togethercomputer/evo-1-8k-base on HuggingFace are released under the same license as the code (Apache-2.0).
Model weights at arcinstitute/evo2_* on HuggingFace are released under the same license as the code (Apache-2.0).
Salesforce released ProGen2 code as BSD-3-Clause; community-published weights at hugohrban/progen2-* declare BSD-3-Clause on their HuggingFace cards.
Profluent releases ProGen3 weights (Profluent-Bio/progen3-* on HuggingFace) under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, which forbids commercial use and propagates a ShareAlike obligation onto any derivative artifact.

proto-tools original client code (MIT) calling the EMBL-EBI AlphaFold DB prediction REST API over plain HTTP; no google-deepmind/alphafold dependency. The predicted structures retrieved are distributed by the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database (alphafold.ebi.ac.uk) under CC-BY-4.0; attribution to AlphaFold and EMBL-EBI is required when redistributing them.

proto-tools original client code (MIT) downloading the pre-computed AlphaMissense CSVs over plain HTTP; no google-deepmind/alphamissense dependency. The predictions are distributed by the AlphaFold Protein Structure Database (alphafold.ebi.ac.uk) under CC-BY-4.0; attribution to AlphaMissense and EMBL-EBI is required when redistributing them.

The client builds on pdbeccdutils (PDBeurope/ccdutils), which is Apache-2.0. The bundled wwPDB Chemical Component Dictionary data (`components.cif.gz`, ~70 MB) is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0 per the wwPDB usage policies; attribution to the wwPDB is encouraged but not required. Optional UniChem cross-references and RCSB PDB usage queries hit external public APIs (EMBL-EBI UniChem, RCSB Search) whose own usage policies apply at request time.

data.name: the Ensembl project
data.text: Ensembl-generated data is available without restriction per Ensembl's disclaimer; attribution to Ensembl and EMBL-EBI is expected under the EMBL-EBI Terms of Use. Some bundled third-party data may carry its own terms.

license.notes: proto-tools original client code (MIT) calling the Ensembl REST API over plain HTTP. Ensembl-generated data is available without restriction; attribution to Ensembl/EMBL-EBI is expected per the EMBL-EBI Terms of Use, and some bundled third-party data may carry its own terms.

data.name: the InterPro classification
data.text: Data accessed via EMBL-EBI's public InterPro REST API and the iprscan5 service is freely usable under the EMBL-EBI Terms of Use. InterPro aggregates member databases (Pfam, SMART, PROSITE, CATH-Gene3D, and others) whose own licenses vary.

license.notes: proto-tools original client code (MIT) calling EBI's public InterPro REST API and iprscan5 submit-and-poll service over plain HTTP. Data accessed via the public InterPro API is freely usable under the EMBL-EBI Terms of Use; member databases aggregated by InterPro have varying terms.

data.name: NCBI's Entrez databases
data.text: NCBI Entrez and the E-utilities are works of the United States Government and are not subject to copyright in the U.S. Data served by NCBI public APIs is in the public domain and may be used, redistributed, and modified without restriction; standard NCBI usage policies (rate limits, attribution to the source database when republishing) apply to the API endpoints.

license.notes: proto-tools original client code (MIT) calling NCBI Entrez E-utilities over plain HTTP. The records retrieved are works of the United States Government, in the public domain; standard NCBI usage policies (rate limits) apply to the API endpoints.

proto-tools original client code (MIT) calling the RCSB PDB Data and FASTA REST endpoints over plain HTTP; there is no py-rcsb-api dependency. PDB archive data is public-domain under CC0-1.0 per the RCSB usage policies.

data.name: the PubChem database
data.text: PubChem is operated by NCBI/NLM/NIH and is a work of the United States Government, not subject to copyright in the U.S. PubChem data and the PUG REST API are in the public domain and may be used, redistributed, and modified without restriction; standard NCBI usage policies apply. Some PubChem records re-distribute third-party content (e.g. vendor catalog data) whose terms are set by the original depositor; consult the per-record source attribution.

license.notes: proto-tools original client code (MIT) calling the PubChem PUG REST API over plain HTTP. PubChem core data is a U.S. Government work in the public domain; some records re-distribute third-party content with depositor-specific terms.

proto-tools original client code (MIT) calling the Rfam website's family, regions, and alignment endpoints over plain HTTP; there is no Rfam client library dependency. All Rfam data is public-domain under CC0-1.0, as stated on rfam.org.

proto-tools original orchestration code (MIT) that federates over the NCBI Entrez, UniProt, and RCSB PDB sibling toolkits. Each underlying source carries its own data terms (NCBI public domain, UniProt CC-BY-4.0, RCSB CC0-1.0); attribution to UniProt is required when UniProt records are redistributed.
UniProt data is released under CC-BY-4.0 by the UniProt consortium (SIB, EMBL-EBI, PIR). Free for any use including commercial; attribution to UniProt is required.

Backofen Lab CRISPRtracrRNA is MIT-licensed; CRISPRidentify (the array-detection step) is also MIT. The Cas-cassette step in complete_run mode invokes CRISPRcasIdentifier (Backofen Lab), which is GPL-3.0 (copyleft), so it is surfaced as a bundled dependency. GPL-3.0 does not restrict commercial use.

FAMPnn (Shuai et al., Stanford) is MIT-licensed; weights released alongside the code under the same terms.
LigandMPNN (Dauparas / Baker Lab) is MIT-licensed including released weights.
ProteinMPNN (Dauparas / Baker Lab) is MIT-licensed including released weights.
AbLang (Olsen et al., Oxford OPIG) is BSD-3-Clause; weights are downloaded by the package and ship under the same terms.

The published Encodon checkpoints (nvidia/NV-CodonFM-Encodon-*-v1 on HuggingFace) are public and commercially usable under the NVIDIA Open Model License. Model redistribution requires including that agreement and NVIDIA's prescribed notice; NVIDIA claims no ownership of model outputs.
Meta AI's ESM-2 codebase and HuggingFace weight checkpoints (facebook/esm2_*) are all MIT-licensed.

ESM3 code and the open esm3_sm_open_v1 weights (HuggingFace biohub/esm3-sm-open-v1) are MIT-licensed under Chan Zuckerberg Biohub copyright. This supersedes the EvolutionaryScale Cambrian Non-Commercial License that previously covered the weights; the repo is also no longer HuggingFace-gated, so no HF_TOKEN is required. Larger ESM3 models remain hosted-API-only and are not wrapped here.

ESM C code and HuggingFace weights (biohub/ESMC-300M, biohub/ESMC-600M, biohub/ESMC-6B) are MIT-licensed under Chan Zuckerberg Biohub copyright, as are the sparse autoencoders trained against them. This supersedes the EvolutionaryScale Cambrian Open / Non-Commercial licenses that previously covered the 300M and 600M checkpoints. The model cards additionally tag 'other', which links only to a third-party dependency notice imposing no terms on users beyond those dependencies' own licenses.
The upstream code LICENSE and both released checkpoint model cards declare Apache-2.0. Redistribution must preserve the applicable license and attribution notices.
The upstream code LICENSE and both released checkpoint model cards declare Apache-2.0. Redistribution must preserve the applicable license and attribution notices.

obligations make pDockQ2 unsuitable for bundling in a proprietary SaaS image
without legal review. Cite the original paper.
